releases.name: Tidying Simulator
releases.summary: Find scattered objects and return them to their proper places in this first-person tidying simulator. Follow silhouettes and a compass, unlock new abilities as you progress, and restore the entire house to perfection!

releases.name: Rutrum
releases.summary: Rutrum is a physics roguelike about dropping gems, popping rocks, and unlocking chests. Build a deck of gems, inscribe them with runes, merge them together to cause damage, touch them to acquire loot from enemies.  DROP, POP, UNLOCK!

releases.name: Mini Mayor: 12 Years
releases.summary: Build your city and survive elections in this city-building management sandbox. Choose campaign promises, manage approval, and aim for three terms. Your choices shape the story and outcome. Will you develop the city or use your power to build your personal fortune?

releases.name: Grimoire Garden: A Taskbar Tale
releases.summary: Grow a magical garden right above your taskbar! Join your apprentice Pip and sparrow Jack Jr. to plant enchanted crops, fight thieving goblins with your typing skills, and earn gold for powerful magic upgrades. Turn your desktop into a peaceful retreat while you work, study, or surf!

releases.name: Supermarket Empire Together
releases.summary: Build a supermarket empire solo or with up to 4 friends. Stock the shelves, set your own prices, work the register by hand, chase down shoplifters and hire a crew — and grow one empty room into the busiest store in town.

releases.name: SquareSlicer
releases.summary: SquareSlicer is a short, incremental game where you slice cubes to unlock abilities that let you slice even more!

releases.name: XenoVector
releases.summary: Pilot one of three ships through an endless procedural bullet-hell roguelike. Dodge escalating formations, hunt evolving bosses, collect run-defining relics, upgrade five weapons and destroy massive multipart Apex Colossi.

releases.name: Beggar Simulator: Istanbul
releases.summary: Work the streets of Istanbul in a first-person comedy job sim: rent an act, read the mark, and back off before the zabıta arrives.

releases.name: Electronics Depot Simulator
releases.summary: Build and manage your own tech depot empire! Purchase product licenses, order inventory from suppliers, stock your shelves, and serve customers in this immersive store management simulation. Start small with basic accessories and work your way up to premium electronics and more.

releases.name: Depths' Tale
releases.summary: Depths’ Tale is a short first-person cosmic horror experience about a lone fisherman working the night shift. Far from shore, only the waves keep you company... for now.

releases.name: Asteroids Arena Online
releases.summary: -Fight others in PvP with movement and physics of a classic. -Survive SOLO or COOP in waves mode. -Use different weapons and powerups to survive. -Get to top of leaderboards

releases.name: Decorate! hololive Sticker Battle
releases.summary: "Decorate! hololive Sticker Battle" is a PvP auto-battler where you decorate your favorite Holomem with stickers and battle against other players.

releases.name: Ember Kingdom
releases.summary: A dark-fantasy, turn-based adventure RPG with deckbuilding-style runs. Choose a hero, shape your talents, read enemy intent, and fight your way back to the lost throne.

releases.name: Deep Core Protocol
releases.summary: Deep Core Protocol is a mining incremental game where you mine ores, upgrade powerful pickaxes and skills, automate your operation with Mining AI, defeat bosses, and push deeper underground through Rebirth and New Game+.

releases.name: Top Check: A Chess Card Game
